messages:
emily: Hey support, getting 400 from POST /v1/rerank. Body attached; seems like top_k ended up as a boolean and candidates is an empty array. Full response: 400 Bad Request - Invalid request schema.

support-bot: [API] request req_0a1b2c rejected: validation failed - "top_k" must be integer, "candidates" must be a non-empty array

sophie (support): Thanks for reporting — can you paste the exact request body and request_id? Quick question: are you using an SDK or rolling your own HTTP call?

emily: here's the body (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "request_id": "req_0a1b2c",
  "top_k": true,
  "items": [],
  "query": "Which plan fits best?"
}
```

emily: curl we used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
 -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...\" \
 -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
 -d '@body.json'
```

raj (eng): I can repro locally with that payload. Our validation schema expects an integer for top_k and a non-empty candidates array (field is usually called \"candidates\"; some older clients use \"items\" which we normalize, but the array must not be empty). The boolean likely got in from a form serialization bug. Can you try: top_k: 3 and candidates: [{"id":"a","text":"option A"}] and resend?

emily: Tried that change and got 200 with scores back. Works now :thumbsup:

sophie (support): Good to hear. We'll do three things: (1) send you a suggested fix/snippet to validate payload client-side, (2) file an engineering ticket to improve the 400 error text to be field-specific, and (3) add an SDK guard to catch boolean top_k and empty candidates at the client level. Assigning to raj.

raj (eng): Filing INF-3214 to improve server errors and add a short-lived acceptance check in the runtime. Prefer not to coerce boolean->int automatically (risk of silent incorrect behavior).

sophie (support): emily, did this come from our Python SDK or a custom client? That helps with whether we push a patch to the SDK.

emily: It was a tiny AWS Lambda using JSON.parse on form data — my bug. I patched it and validated. Thanks for the fast help.

sophie (support): Thanks — marking resolved from support side. We'll keep INF-3214 open for the error-message work. Will ping here when deployed. :white_check_mark:
